title: Board Statement on Disaster Relief: Default Interest Where an Assigned Crop Insurance Indemnity Has Arrived (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
**Statement.** Disaster relief applies to the default-rate interest entry on a Farm Real Estate Loans installment where a Crop Insurance indemnity paid jointly to the member and the association under an assignment arrived in the last 6 months: when that indemnity is at least the principal share of the installment (the installment amount less its billed interest), the entry is half of the figure worked out; when such an indemnity arrived but is smaller than the principal share, the entry is three quarters of that figure; when no such indemnity arrived, the entry is the full figure. The relief is applied to the unrounded figure before the single rounding to cents.

## What the records show

- **The indemnity.** In the member's Crop Insurance transaction history, indemnity payments whose payee is the member and the association jointly, with an effective date in the last 6 months; all such payments in that time are taken together.
- **The principal share.** The loan's installment amount less the interest billed on the installment considered.

## Relief schedule

| Assigned indemnity in the last 6 months | Entry |
|---|---|
| at least the principal share | half of the figure (multiplied by 0.5) |
| more than zero but smaller than the principal share | three quarters of the figure (multiplied by 0.75) |
| none | the full figure |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

An installment of USD 9000.00 carried USD 3400.00 of billed interest, so its principal share is USD 5600.00. Suppose the unrounded default-interest figure is 1167.945205.

| Assigned indemnity received in the last 6 months | Relief | Entry, rounded once to cents |
|---|---|---|
| USD 6000.00 | half | 583.972603, so 583.97 |
| USD 5600.00 (exactly the principal share) | half | 583.97 |
| USD 2000.00 | three quarters | 875.958904, so 875.96 |
| none (or only an indemnity paid to the member alone) | full | 1167.95 |

An indemnity received seven months ago does not fall in the last 6 months.
